question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Someone who dishonestly pretends to deceive under an assumed character
solution:
The correct answer is **"Imposter."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Imposter"** means someone who dishonestly pretends to be someone else in order to deceive others. (छद्मवेशी, पररूपधारक, बहुरूपिया)

 
 
• **Example:** *The man was an **imposter**__ who had tricked the entire company with his fake credentials.*
 
 
 
• Someone who dishonestly pretends to deceive under an assumed character means **"Imposter."**
 
• The correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Imitator:** A person who copies or mimics the behavior, actions, or style of someone else. **(अनुकरणकर्ता)**
 
• **Explorer: **A person who travels to unfamiliar places to discover or investigate new things. **(खोजकर्ता)**
 
• **Imbecile: **It is used to describe someone who is considered foolish, stupid, or lacking intelligence.** (मूर्ख)**
